description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Created and queried through the console. Only a single ID is supported.
Channel ID. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流。
description.en: Specifies which users' audio streams to subscribe to in the room.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流。
description.en: Specifies which users' camera streams to subscribe to in the room.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流。
description.en: Specifies which users' screen sharing streams to subscribe to in the room.

description.zh: 指定该任务订阅的用户列表。
description.en: Specifies the list of users that the task subscribes to.

description.zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，和[StartRecordTask](~~193528~~)入参TaskId一致。
description.en: Task ID. Only a single ID is supported, and it must be the same as the TaskId input parameter of [StartRecordTask](~~193528~~).
Configuration template ID. To obtain the template ID, see [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~).

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流。
description.en: Specifies which users' audio streams in the room are not subscribed to.

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流。
description.en: Specifies which users' camera streams in the room are not subscribed to.

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流。
description.en: Specifies which users' screen sharing streams in the room are not subscribed to.

description.zh: 当前布局的图片框位列表。
description.en: List of image pane positions in the current layout.

description.zh:
窗格ID。N的取值：**1~16**。PaneID的取值：**0~15**。

> 当指定的PaneId用户找不到的话，会默认显示其他的流，流的确定是根据用户加入频道的顺序。
description.en:
Pane ID. N value: **1 to 16**. PaneID value: **0 to 15**.

> If the user specified by PaneId cannot be found, other streams are displayed by default. The streams are determined based on the order in which users join the channel.

description.zh:
对应布局的用户视频输入。取值：

- **camera**（默认）：视频流。
- **shareScreen**：共享屏幕流。

N的取值：**1~16**。
description.en:
User video input corresponding to the layout. Valid values:

- **camera** (default): Video stream.
- **shareScreen**: Screen sharing stream.

N value: **1 to 16**.

description.zh: 当前布局的文字框位列表。
description.en: List of text pane positions in the current layout.

description.zh: 对应布局框格的用户ID。N的取值：**1~16**。
description.en: User ID corresponding to the layout pane. N value: **1 to 16**.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[StartRecordTask](~~193528~~)开始录制视频任务。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage Notes
Before calling this API, you must have already called [StartRecordTask](~~193528~~) to start the video recording task.
# QPS Limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please call the API reasonably. For more information, see [QPS Limit](~~341645~~).
